scope: Three original finite P1/E4 CPU oracle controls: one near-extremal invariant ray, finite symplectic chart/null/history refusals and3 connection events; no E2 control, all-event proof, full P1/E4/science/Mandatory or release qualification.

initial_covariant_momentum.p_r: positive sqrt(-non_radial / inverse[1][1]) from original KerrMetricD inverse

AnalyticValidationTest.NearExtremalKerrC.integration: Original adaptive Hamiltonian absolute and relative tolerances1e-13; up to250 complete unit-affine spans, stopping on r>=200. Original default step and maximum-step controls remain unchanged.
AnalyticValidationTest.NearExtremalKerrC.assertions: Every unit span complete; final radius>=200; maximum absolute E drift<1e-10, relative Lz drift<1e-10 and Q drift/max(abs(initial_Q),1e-30)<1e-10.
AnalyticValidationTest.NearExtremalKerrC.scope_boundary: One original outgoing near-extremal Boyer-Lindquist ray. Oracle-side invariant witness, not live Cartesian/Vulkan conservation, capture, 1080p shadow or a full P1 claim.

AnalyticValidationTest.SymplecticChartEx.fixtures: Original flat near-axis Yoshida4 step1e-3 with null projection disabled; Schwarzschild impossible-null-root, infinite radial momentum and invalid axis near horizon; explicit periodic-null-projection schedule.
AnalyticValidationTest.SymplecticChartEx.assertions: Chart exit remains distinct from constraint failure; integrate retains last represented state and zero accepted steps on chart exit; invalid chart state is not capture; identical explicit schedule state produces identical q/p; accepted_steps_before=1 produces original constraint failure.
AnalyticValidationTest.SymplecticChartEx.scope_boundary: Original finite outcome/refusal/history controls only; no added fixture, domain or numerical threshold.

OracleConnection.AnalyticConnectionAgree.reference: Original NumericChristoffel central differences of KerrMetricD.Evaluate with h=1e-6*max(1,abs(x[sigma]))+1e-8, contracted with the same sampled inverse metric.
OracleConnection.AnalyticConnectionAgree.assertions: At each of3 original events, maximum absolute difference over64 Christoffel components from KerrChristoffel <1e-9.
OracleConnection.AnalyticConnectionAgree.independence_limit: Independent metric differentiation and connection assembly use the same Boyer-Lindquist metric/inverse authority. No independent all-event metric oracle or E2 transport control is selected.
